//: Trace IDs whose node no longer exists on the page, and which prose may still cite.
//why: A decision record has to be able to name the figure it withdrew. Deleting the citation would erase the record; leaving it uncatalogued makes check-citations report a dangling reference on every run, which trains everyone to ignore the guard. A row here says: this id is gone ON PURPOSE, here is what happened to it. An id NOT in this file and NOT in the ledger is still a real error — a typo, or a doc written against a stale run.
